metadata.description: Claude Code plugins the RelayMint team uses to build software with AI agents, shared in the open.

plugins.name: spa-kit
plugins.description: A factory for client SPAs that classic search crawlers and AI answer engines can both read. Generates a standalone Next.js site from a declarative brief, derives the whole OKLCH palette from one brand hex with enforced contrast targets, and verifies it with three independent oracles: a no-JavaScript crawler probe, a blind breaker, and a Playwright suite (visual, a11y, motion contract, web vitals). Includes the /spa-kit interview skill.
